notes: Manual or automatic opening dice for Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe; dice disappear after the reveal. Won boards show fuchsia hearts and purple X symbols with chartreuse highlights. Compact ending recaps and five-second hearts, sparkles and fireworks. A tiny pink piggy surprises both Ivan and Lexie only when they are the only two room players, up to twice per match. Existing rooms and saved games are preserved.
